title: Abba Samukid
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bamidbar Rabbah 3:7: Rabbi Berekhyah [and] Rabbi Chelbo in his name.

We find in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:1: “Rabbi Berekhyah and Rabbi Chelbo in the name of Rabbi Abba Sumka: Even the hooves of the beasts,” etc. Hyman considers it very likely that he is Rabbi Abba HaAdmoni (the Ruddy), for the Jerusalem Talmud is cited in Yalkut, Joshua, remez 33, as: Rabbi Berekhyah in the name of Rabbi Abba HaAdmoni.

notes.text: HaAdmoni is rendered consistently, with “the Ruddy” as its gloss. The proposed identification remains Hyman’s strongly qualified conjecture, not a new identity binding.
